title: Models: assistants are on Claude; OpenRouter is $0 today

owner_note.text: The voice assistants are already on Claude (fast = Haiku 5.5, smart = Sonnet 5.5 after the restart; OpenRouter spend in the last 24 h is $0). What the smart assistant told you was stale: until 10-12 midday the voice pair ran on openai/gpt-6-luna (OpenRouter), and the registry still lists 105 parked Echo rows on google/gemini-3.8-flash from 10-08, none running. The Echo already stayed on Claude (the OpenRouter pause default); it is now fixed to the scan tier (Haiku), and the old Gemini trial code is gone. Changes (commit e33baa3f1) take effect at the next Servex restart, which I did not do. The wall switch is two-way: `node Server/models-now.mjs --backend openrouter|anthropic`, then restart; flipping it also lifts the OpenRouter pause, which would otherwise have refused every spawn. See which agent runs what, live: /framework/ai/models (refresh with `node Server/models-now.mjs --write`).
